name: Mercor
summary: Mercor operates a talent network that helps AI labs and enterprises source, evaluate, and manage expert human work.
overview: Mercor operates a talent network that helps AI labs and enterprises source, evaluate, and manage expert human work.
bull_case: As AI labs and enterprises demand more specialist evaluation and training work, Mercor can build a valuable marketplace through expert supply, workflow software and customer relationships.
bear_case: The marketplace is exposed to customer concentration and changes in AI-training demand. A $10B valuation requires repeatable economics and differentiation beyond talent matching.

intelligence.description: Mercor operates a talent network that helps AI labs and enterprises source, evaluate, and manage expert human work.
company: Mercor operates a talent network that helps AI labs and enterprises source, evaluate and manage expert human work. The company positions the product as infrastructure for accessing subject-matter expertise alongside workflow and evaluation tools.

Mercor announced a $350M Series C at a $10B valuation in October 2025. Its long-term value depends on sustaining both specialist supply and demand as the mix of AI training and evaluation work changes.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Mercor is exposed to one of the less visible constraints in AI: high-quality human expertise for model training and evaluation. Its progress is a useful indicator of whether AI-labor marketplaces can become durable infrastructure businesses.

changed.text: Raised $350M Series C at a $10B valuation.

takeaways: The latest Series C valued Mercor at $10B.
The company sells access to a network of experts and AI-workflow infrastructure.
Customer concentration and the durability of AI-training demand are key watch items.
